name: Ben Whitlock
text: The dropshipping-is-dead crowd has mostly never run a store in the last two years. This is the first piece that actually describes what changed instead of just declaring it dead. Bookmarked.

name: Aisha Rahman
text: Joined after a friend kept going on about the 'train' thing. Two weeks in and the day by day pacing is honestly the only reason I have not quit like I did with every other course I bought.

name: Greg Tan
text: Fair point about POD as a lower risk on-ramp. That is exactly how I started before moving into proper dropshipping. Wish someone had framed it this way three years ago.

name: Mara Devlin
text: The line about most programs still teaching the 2019 version is painfully accurate. I burned a year on tactics that stopped working before I even finished the modules.

name: Tomas Ferreira
text: Found this through a forum thread, not an ad, which tracks with the whole they barely advertise angle. Looking into it properly this weekend.
